inertials: All 13 moving bodies use URDF mass, COM and full tensor. Fixed 0.15 kg toes merged into 0.064 kg shanks with parallel-axis theorem. Body inertia axes follow URDF. URDF COM signs retained as supplied (not mirrored or inferred).
geometry: Original MJCF joint frames, axes, meshes and lengths 0.062/0.209/0.18 m retained. IMU aligned to body. Visual meshes have no inferred mass. Runtime installs 12 ordered PD actuators and floor/contact sensors.
asset_license: No model license file was present in the supplied quadruped-team tree; no license for these assets is inferred.

inertia_repair.method: URDF thigh tensors violate the rigid-body principal-moment triangle inequality. Apply minimum Frobenius-norm correction in principal axes: add excess/3 to the two smaller moments and subtract excess/3 from the largest (1e-10 margin). Preserve eigenvectors, mass and COM. No global balanceinertia averaging.

code_sources.legged-gym-mujoco: Base environment, CPU batch simulator, task/runner layout and evaluation; BSD-3-Clause with Apache-2.0 MDP adaptation.
code_sources.CPG-RL: Reference CPG equations/action mapping and PPO settings; EPFL MIT notice retained.
